name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.31.1: the last two dateless timestamps now carry a date. A release's publish time and a machine's last update check both rendered a bare clock time through fmtTime, so a release published last week read as '14:22' with nothing saying which day - the same defect fixed for order rows in v6.26.1, in the two places it was left. Both now use a new fmtDateTime without seconds, since a publish time to the second is noise where an order matched against a Nayax transaction is not. Both date+time formatters share one core, so the falsy guard exists in exactly one place rather than being fixed in half of them: new Date(null) and new Date(0) are the epoch, a valid date, and would otherwise render as a confident 01 Jan 1970. fmtTime and fmtTimeS are removed - this change orphaned fmtTime and v6.26.1 orphaned fmtTimeS, and both were verified to have no remaining call sites. Frontend only. Cumulative over v6.31.
